=== coi ro do .i mi'e .eduard. ===

29/Nov/2013

I have been learning Lojban for a while, exactly how long I am not entirely sure; I would guess I started in about year 2011. I have a collection of reason why I began studying Lojban, the original was it interested me from a philosophical perspective. At the time I was studying my first year of philosophy A level. However as I developed other interests I saw it's potential in other subjects. I am still working towards the ability to use Lojban to describe Philosophical ideas but I intend to persist.

I also study Go, a subtle strategic Chinese board game. I am very pleased to see there is a Lojban computer on the KGS web-sight.
